method.aria: Share Card methodology privacy and export limits
method.title: Methodology, privacy, and export limits
method.identity: Rows are accepted only after record, positive-integer ID, duplicate-ID, timestamp, and half-open selected-window checks.
method.metrics: Each metric has an independent valid/missing denominator. Measured zero remains valid; malformed or absent values remain unknown.
method.efficiency: Consumption is distance-weighted only across rows with positive measured distance and nonnegative measured drive energy.
method.timezone: Month, weekday, and active-day buckets use {{timezone}}; URL calendar labels remain distinct from RFC3339 query instants.
method.privacy: The representative directory and SVG omit exact addresses, coordinates, paths, VINs, and vehicle location.
method.export: The 800×418 SVG is deterministic, XML-escaped, generated locally, and downloaded through a delayed object-URL cleanup.
method.capLimit: The history cap was reached. Every export is labeled as an observed capped sample and must not be read as complete range or lifetime evidence.
method.returnedLimit: Exports describe returned selected-window evidence only; they do not certify complete lifetime or range coverage.

staticHint.heading: Static share cards
staticHint.body: Every drive in TeslaSync can be published as a static, redacted share card from the drive detail page. Open a drive, click "Share", and copy the public link — anyone with the link can view the static card, no AI required.

preview.heading: Share preview
preview.privacy: Only this redacted summary is shared — never raw coordinates or addresses.
preview.empty: Select a trip above to preview what you’ll share.

aiTripPostcard.title: Draft a Helix share-card image
aiTripPostcard.description: Ask Helix to draft a propose-only image prompt and preview spec for the selected trip's share card. Helix only sees the redacted trip context (distance, duration, drive count, vehicle name) — never raw coordinates or street addresses. The draft is never published automatically; review it here, then use the existing Share button on the trip to publish a static share card.
aiTripPostcard.noTripHint: Pick a trip from the list above to enable Helix.
